> ## ⚠️ DO NOT INCLUDE TOKENS OR AUTH FILE CONTENTS
>
> Never paste access tokens, refresh tokens, ID tokens, API keys, the contents of
> `~/.codex/auth.json`, Keychain items, cookies or `Authorization` headers into
> this issue — not in text, not in a screenshot, not in a log excerpt.
>
> Use **Settings → Advanced → Copy Diagnostics**. That output has tokens, home
> paths and e-mail addresses already stripped. Please still read it before
> pasting it.
>
> If the bug itself is about credentials leaking, stop and read
> [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) instead — report it privately.
